For example, although most of his novel Foundation consists of people discussing science and politics and we find out little about his characters' lives, Asimov wanted to convey the vast sweep of human history over centuries, and one of his points is that at such a timescale, individuals don't matter. Thus his lack of characterization is central to his thematic aims. 题目 94% - 0.22 0.03% Question 6 Based on the texts, how would the author of Text 2 most likely respond to the description of Asimov's characters in the underlined portion of Text 1? Unlike ferritic stainless steel, austenitic stainless steel has a face-centered cubic crystalline structure resulting from the addition of nickel to the alloy.
